# GX Bible

GX Bible is a powerful, free Bible reader built natively for Meta Quest — 
read God's Word in immersive comfort, right in your VR space.

## 📖 TRANSLATIONS
- Access 1,000+ Bible translations from around the world
- Spanish, English, and hundreds of other languages
- Add or remove translations as you need them
- Download translations for offline reading — no internet required

## ✝️ READING PLANS
- Bible in a Year — read the full Bible in 365 days
- NT in 90 Days — focus on the New Testament
